item.title: More dads taking paid family leave for a new baby, sometimes as much as moms are
item.description: The U.S. has no national law for paid parental leave. But in states that do, more dads are using the benefit, sometimes more than moms. The change comes as Americans say having kids is unaffordable.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Independent candidates sense a moment in the West. Democrats are hoping they're right
item.description: As they look to win the Senate, Democrats are hoping that independent candidates in Nebraska and Montana can help them topple Republicans in a part of the country where their own brand is hurting.

item.title: Soldiers guard center of Milan as thousands of protesters march in cities across Europe
item.description: While protests in France have claimed most international attention, large demonstrations also rocked many European cities Saturday from Milan to Rome to Madrid, Lisbon and Tirana.

item.title: Drought, fire and high diesel prices 'addin' up tough' for Oregon ranchers
item.description: Record diesel prices are kicking Western ranchers while they're down. Drought means they have to buy extra hay, and pay truckers extra to deliver it because of fuel price hikes.
